title: Solo run clear head
summary: On August 19, Jordan went for a solo run at Greenwood Park, tackling the hill trail extension for the first time and taking in the skyline view despite the burning legs. During the run, Jordan worked through the math on the upcoming lease decision and decided to renew rather than move, reasoning that staying is cheaper and the neighborhood—close to Groundwork and the park—already feels like home. Jordan came home feeling settled and assured, unwinding with Pepper, Thai takeout, and a Motown documentary.
